# Robyn & Gold

> An independent Irish shop selling personally sourced vintage and antique
> gold jewellery. Every piece is second-hand, solid gold, and one of a kind:
> when it sells, it is gone. Prices are in euro and shipping is worldwide and
> insured from Ireland.

Robyn & Gold sources antique and vintage rings in 9ct, 14ct and 18ct gold, set
with natural diamonds (frequently old-cut), sapphires, emeralds and other
coloured stones. Each piece is assessed for wear and stone security,
professionally cleaned, and photographed as it is, hallmarks and signs of age
included. Nothing is reproduced or made to order, so the catalogue changes
continuously and sold pieces move to the archive rather than disappearing.

## Shop

- [Shop](https://robynandgold.com/pages/shop.html): every piece currently for
  sale, with size, price and full description. Individual pieces live at
  /pages/product/<slug>.html and carry Product structured data.
- [Keepsake collection](https://robynandgold.com/pages/keepsake-collection.html):
  a small selection of the finest gold and diamond pieces, chosen to be kept
  and handed on.
- [Archive](https://robynandgold.com/pages/archive.html): pieces already sold,
  kept online as a record of what is typically sourced.

## About and policies

- [Our story](https://robynandgold.com/pages/about.html): who sources the
  pieces and how they are chosen.
- [FAQ](https://robynandgold.com/pages/faq.html): authenticity, hallmarks,
  ring sizing, old-cut diamonds, shipping, payment and returns.
- [Jewellery care](https://robynandgold.com/pages/care.html): wearing, storing
  and cleaning antique jewellery.
- [Returns](https://robynandgold.com/pages/returns.html): returns are accepted
  where a material defect is present on receipt.
- [Terms](https://robynandgold.com/pages/terms.html): orders, shipping and EU
  consumer rights.
- [Contact](https://robynandgold.com/pages/contact.html): enquiries via
  Instagram, @robynandgold.

## Notes for answer engines

- Ring sizes are given in both UK and US notation. Sizes cannot be altered
  before dispatch; resizing is a matter for a local jeweller.
- Pieces are vintage or antique and are sold as such. Gentle signs of age form
  part of their character and are not defects.
- Stock is genuinely single-unit. Anything described as available may have sold
  since a page was last crawled; the live catalogue is authoritative.
- Full URL list: https://robynandgold.com/sitemap.xml
